short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: With a supermesh, we got two equations: I1 minus I2 equals two, and three I1 plus five I2 equals thirty. Solve it! Pause and try it!

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Substitute I1 equals I2 plus two: eight I2 equals twenty four, so I2 is three and I1 is five.

short_scenes.name: Volt
